title: Fee Relief Matrix, Medical Records Requests
content:
Whether a Medical Records Requests fee can be relieved depends first on the request type. The matrix shows, for each type, which grounds of relief the type offers and how many of its requests per patient are fulfilled free of fees in a rolling 12 months.

| Request type | Records sent to a treating provider for continuity of care | Records supporting a Social Security disability or VA benefits claim | Current financial-hardship approval | Records delivered after the due date | Free requests per patient in a rolling 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | No | No | No | No | 0 |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | Yes | No | No | No | 0 |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | No | Yes | No | Yes | 0 |
| Certified Legal Records Package | No | No | No | No | 0 |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |

"Yes" in the first four columns means the fee is waived on that ground under that type; for the hardship column it means the fee may be waived on a current financial-hardship approval. "No" means the type does not offer that ground.

## The matrix read by type

- **Patient Electronic Copy Request, Patient Paper Copy Request and Imaging Disc Copy Request** offer all four grounds and one free request per patient in a rolling 12 months.
- **Provider-to-Provider Transfer** offers only the continuity-of-care ground and no free request.
- **Third-Party Authorized Release** offers the benefits-claim ground and the late-delivery ground, with no free request.
- **Certified Legal Records Package** and **Portal Self-Service Download** offer none of the four grounds and no free request.

## The matrix read by ground

- A benefits-claim waiver is offered by the Patient Electronic Copy Request, the Patient Paper Copy Request, the Third-Party Authorized Release and the Imaging Disc Copy Request.
- A hardship waiver is offered only by the Patient Electronic Copy Request, the Patient Paper Copy Request and the Imaging Disc Copy Request.
- A late-delivery waiver is offered by the Patient Electronic Copy Request, the Patient Paper Copy Request, the Third-Party Authorized Release and the Imaging Disc Copy Request.
